(NewsNation) — Amazon has dethroned Walmart as America’s largest company by revenue, ending a 13-year run atop the Fortune 500 list. The e-commerce giant secured the No. 1 spot on Fortune’s annual rankings with more than $715 billion in revenue in 2025 — a 12% jump from the prior year. UnitedHealth Group remained at No. 3 with nearly $450 billion in revenue, followed by Apple ($416B) and Alphabet, the parent company of Google ($403B). ***The 10 largest U.S. companies by revenue (Fortune 2026)***. Together, Fortune 500 companies represent two-thirds of U.S. GDP, combining for $21 trillion in revenue and $2.1 trillion in profits last year, the magazine said. Alphabet was the most profitable company on the list with $132 billion in earnings — a Fortune 500 record. Chipmaker Nvidia stands out for its meteoric rise, ranking 16th by revenue but surpassing Apple to become the most valuable company, with a market value of more than $4 trillion.
